newsitem.title: USA: Ecopetrol seeks buyers for mid-Jan Vasconia crude.
newsitem.headline: Ecopetrol seeks buyers for mid-Jan Vasconia crude.

text.p: Colombia's state oil company Ecopetrol is selling 500,000 barrels of Vasconia crude for mid-January, trade sources said Wednesday.
The cargo would be delivered January 12-15, 1997.
Traders said Ecopetrol was asking February West Texas Intermediate minus $1.80 a barrel fob.
"This (price) sounds expensive. Vasconia usually sells for around $2.00 under WTI," one trader said.
Shell was also heard to be selling a Vasconia cargo for delivery around the same dates.
Meanwhile, British Petroleum is still selling a Cusiana cargo for late December.
Elsewhere, Chile's state oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) is scheduled to award a contract this evening for 960,000 barrels of crude for delivery January 14-17.
